how_to_use.ask_simply: Ask in plain words which chart to create or change: which metric, by which column and how to see it.
how_to_use.name_the_chart: Name the chart by its title to avoid ambiguity.
how_to_use.modes: In Advanced mode changes are saved straight to the dashboard; in Guided mode it shows them first and asks you to confirm.

keep_in_mind.your_data: It only uses the data available to your user, and some options can only be changed in the dashboard manager: it will tell you which.
keep_in_mind.can_be_wrong: It can be wrong: check figures and filters before publishing.
keep_in_mind.no_memory: It does not remember previous conversations when you start a new chat.

advance.label: Advanced
advance.description: Works fast: it processes your request and changes the chart right away.

guided.label: Guided
guided.description: Walks you through the process: it helps you with each decision, step by step.
